Amazing Mexican Tapas in Ho Chi Minh City
Nov 2025 • Friends
I recently visited along with my friends a top Mexican tapas spot in Ho Chi Minh, and it was fantastic. The atmosphere was lively yet relaxed, and every dish—from the tacos to the ceviche—was full of fresh, bold flavors. The cocktails, especially the margaritas and mezcal mixes, were excellent. Service was friendly and attentive, making the whole experience feel effortless.

A great place for anyone craving quality Mexican bites in the city. I’ll definitely be back!

Delicious Latin food + Incredible Ambiance
Jun 2025 • Family
Mamacita is truly a “can’t miss” restaurant here in Ho Chi Minh. Visiting on the strong recommendation of a local friend, we were thrilled to find such a gem of a restaurant. The authentic Latin fusion flavors were a delight, from the first bite chips & guacamole and ceviche appetizers to the churros for dessert. 

The traditional cocktails like the margarita were excellent, but the signature drinks whipped up by the skilled bartenders were even better. Don’t miss the Mama Moti drink, and if it’s not on the menu make sure to ask your server it’s available. 

For dinner we loved the pork belly tacos, spinach salad, & steak filets, but our favorite of all was the salmon bomb - a flavor explosion unlike any other. The service was first rate, all with an aesthetic ambiance. 

Dont miss this unique culinary experience with authentic Latin flavors!

Wow Vibes
May 2025 • Friends
I had dinner at Mamasita today and it was absolutely fantastic! After many years of living in Vietnam, this was the first time I tasted such incredibly delicious and truly authentic Latin American food. Every dish felt like it came straight from Latin America, yet the flavors are very accessible and enjoyable for European tastes as well. I was genuinely impressed.

The restaurant itself is cozy and welcoming, with a lovely open veranda that makes the atmosphere even more special. A huge thank you to the owner and director, Julio, who greeted me personally and shared his vision of spreading Mexican culture around the world. His passion and dedication really resonated with me, and it shows in every detail of this wonderful place.

I also want to express my gratitude to the entire service team. They were incredibly attentive, noticing every little need without ever being intrusive. Special thanks to Tuan, my server, who was exceptionally thoughtful and made sure everything was perfect throughout the evening. It’s rare to find such attentive service in Vietnam — truly impressive.

Mamasita is a gem and a place I will definitely return to. Thank you to the whole team for a memorable evening!
